item.description:
New in 0.1.6

Heads up, the modifier keys changed. Hold ⇧ for the Pointer (select and shift things), hold ⌘ for Paint. ⌥-drag still duplicates. The old hold-⇧-to-paint is retired.

  • Rules. Settings → Rules styles events by what they are: a badge on the corner (a star, a flag, any emoji, in any color), a glow behind the event, or a mute that grays it out. Match on title, notes, location, invitees, calendar, duration, or all-day, with "all" or "any" of your conditions. A live count shows how many events a rule catches as you type. Video calls come badged out of the box.
  • Multi-select. ⇧-click events to select several, or ⇧-click an edge to select an edit point. Drag a selection to move every event together, or drag a selected edge to trim them all at once, the shortest event stops the group. One Save confirms; one Undo reverts. Esc clears, Delete removes the lot. Hovering an edge shows which edge you have: ⇤ for a start, ⇥ for an end.
  • Only overlaps stack. A single conflict no longer shrinks the whole lane. Events that overlap stack together; everything else keeps full height.
  • Now follows. Double-click Now and the playhead sits dead center while the timeline moves under it. Single-click Now jumps to today, midnight-left. Any pan turns follow off; zoom keeps it. N toggles it from the keyboard.
  • Small things. Outside titles and times are darker. Group rows carry a hairline boundary. Long addresses wrap inside the card. Row highlight on hover is off by default (Settings turns it on).

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@trytimecal.com.
